#create Data
#install.packages("readxl")
#library(readxl)
install.packages("readxl", type = "binary")
library(readxl)
mydata <- read_excel("C:/AUCA/Data_Class.xlsx")

# Display the data
View(mydata)

#understanding mydata
head(mydata)
tail(mydata)
summary(mydata)
summary(mydata$Weight)
length(mydata$Weight)
# Data Visualization Using ggplot2
# Install and load ggplot2
install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
w <- mydata[, c("Weight", "Height")]
View(w)
hist(w$Weight)
plot(w$Weight,w$Height,
main="Student data",
xlab="Weight",
ylab="Height")
boxplot(w$Weight, w$Height,
        names = c("Weight", "Height"),
        main = "Student Weight and Height",
        col = c("skyblue", "lightgreen"),
        ylab = "Values")
#Find Missing variable
is.na(mydata)
# Filling missing values
alldata <- mydata
alldata[is.na(alldata)] <- 99
